failure_criterion: the primary anchor is not locatable across the panel
declared_threshold: a family is ANCHOR_POOR below 90 percent dyad occupancy
why_this_threshold: the bar is set from the MEASURED distribution before any frame is built, and 7 families already fall below it: UG13 52.0, UG23 66.7, UG15 69.2, UG21 69.6, G2L 76.4, UG12 86.5, Retrons 89.6
consequence_if_triggered: those families are predeclared ANCHOR_POOR and require a second anchor before they enter the common frame; a low mapping rate there is a property of the reference material, not a biological finding

failure_criterion: no second anchor can be established
measured_on: A_POCH_MOTIFS and A_RVT1_STATES occupancy, both currently UNMEASURED
declared_threshold: at least two anchors locatable in at least 90 percent of panel proteins
why_this_threshold: a single-anchor frame cannot establish ORDER, and order is the cheapest evidence of homologous correspondence
consequence_if_triggered: the common frame is abandoned; fall back to class-level coordinate systems

failure_criterion: anchor order is not consistent across families
measured_on: V02 ordered-anchor rate, on methods able to emit disorder
why_this_threshold: inconsistent order between families means the anchors are not corresponding features
consequence_if_triggered: that lineage gets its own coordinate system
denominator: proteins with at least two anchors

failure_criterion: correspondence collapses below an identity threshold
declared_threshold: identify the bin at which callability drops below 50 percent, declared as the frame's SCOPE rather than as a pass or fail
why_this_threshold: a coordinate system has a domain of validity; naming it is the honest alternative to pretending it is universal
consequence_if_triggered: the frame is reported WITH its identity scope, and application outside that scope is refused rather than extrapolated

failure_criterion: a whole withheld family cannot be mapped
declared_threshold: below 50 percent for a withheld family
why_this_threshold: the capability this redesign buys; a frame that cannot reach a withheld family is not general
consequence_if_triggered: that family is out of frame scope and is reported as such

failure_criterion: a whole withheld LINEAGE cannot be mapped
declared_threshold: below 50 percent for a withheld lineage
why_this_threshold: stronger than F05 and the real test of generality
consequence_if_triggered: the common frame is abandoned for that lineage

measured_on: V07 with Retron withheld, compared against the distribution of other withheld lineages
declared_threshold: retron callability more than 2 standard deviations below the other lineages
why_this_threshold: this is the operator's explicit condition for a retron-specific extension, and it must be measured rather than assumed
consequence_if_triggered: a retron coordinate EXTENSION is proposed - an extension of the shared frame reporting where it diverges, never a second independent frame

failure_criterion: the frame moves when the panel is rebuilt
measured_on: V09 panel sensitivity under UG_OPTION_A versus UG_OPTION_B
declared_threshold: anchor coordinates shifting by more than the stability interval
why_this_threshold: the UG allocation question could not be settled in this task; F08 makes the unsettled choice auditable instead of hidden
consequence_if_triggered: the frame is reported as panel-conditional and the UG question escalates to the operator

declared_threshold: a column is NON-HOMOLOGOUS unless stable across the declared alignment methods
why_this_threshold: an MSA emits a column whether or not the residues are homologous
consequence_if_triggered: unstable columns are masked out of the core and reported as masked

why_this_threshold: if fewer than two anchors are locatable AND no withheld lineage maps, there is no common frame to build
consequence_if_triggered: Stage 2 lands the reference inventory, the anchor occupancy measurement and a documented impossibility result, and closes. This is an acceptable outcome and the launcher's whole-track kill criterion already contemplates it

failure_criterion: the fallback ladder, declared before any derivation
consequence_if_triggered: global RT anchors, then class-level coordinate systems, then family-specific architecture. Failure at one level falls to the next rather than forcing the level above
